title: Suggestion for leaderboard: Show UTC time for both first and last star
description: Hi! Thanks for this tool, I quite enjoy it! I'm curious, would you mind expanding the leaderboard tables to allow showing the time both of the first and second star?

title: Missing tzdata dependency
description:
I installed the library but when I tried to run my first command ("elf input 2024 1"), i received the following error log:

  File "<frozen importlib._bootstrap>", line 1398, in _gcd_import
  File "<frozen importlib._bootstrap>", line 1371, in _find_and_load
  File "<frozen importlib._bootstrap>", line 1314, in _find_and_load_unlocked
  File "<frozen importlib._bootstrap>", line 491, in _call_with_frames_removed
  File "<frozen importlib._bootstrap>", line 1398, in _gcd_import
  File "<frozen importlib._bootstrap>", line 1371, in _find_and_load
  File "<frozen importlib._bootstrap>", line 1314, in _find_and_load_unlocked
  File "<frozen importlib._bootstrap>", line 491, in _call_with_frames_removed
  File "<frozen importlib._bootstrap>", line 1398, in _gcd_import
  File "<frozen importlib._bootstrap>", line 1371, in _find_and_load
  File "<frozen importlib._bootstrap>", line 1335, in _find_and_load_unlocked
ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'tzdata'

installing tzdata (uv add tzdata) fixed the issue

title: Allow setting user-agent info to identify the end-user, not just the library
description: Per Wastl's (AoC's author) request on the subreddit here https://www.reddit.com/r/adventofcode/comments/1pa472d/reminder_please_throttle_your_aoc_traffic/ Elf should set the user's (not the library's) contact information inside the User-Agent header.
